root: ^Brooklyn stands before an ornate mirror, two silent servants adjusting her hair. She doesn't turn when you enter.

g-0: ^"The music is rather tiresome tonight, don't you think? All pomp, no passion."
g-1: ^"You, tell me you're not here to discuss the weather or compliment my dress like the last five idiots."

s: ^"The masquerade seems to be going well."
^"I noticed the Prince isn't by your side."

masquerade_talk: ^"Going well? Darling, it's a carefully orchestrated performance. Everyone's wearing two masks tonight—the one on their face and the one they wear every day."

g-1: ^"Although, I must say, watching Gaten stumble through small talk is always entertaining. My dear brother has all the charm of a trained parrot."
g-2: ^"He even glances toward Alistair's usual corner before answering questions, like a dog waiting for commands. Pathetic, really."

prince_talk: ^"Gaten? My dear brother is likely wherever his master told him to stand. You know, when we were children, he used to make his own decisions."

g-0: ^"Now he can't choose a dinner wine without looking over his shoulder."
g-2: ^"But I suppose that's what happens when you're raised to be a monument instead of a man."

tension_talk: ^"Tension? That's court, darling. Everyone smiling with knives behind their backs. Though I'll admit, Flora looked particularly murderous earlier."

g-0: ^"I heard Alistair made quite the public jest about her... prospects. A woman scorned and a noble humiliated? That's a dangerous combination."
g-1: ^Brooklyn pauses, her reflection catching yours in the glass.
g-2: ^"Then again, dangerous is relative when you're already living in a cage."
